# IRIS PROVENANCE
Purpose: preserve traceability of important visual decisions.

Record for each material claim or transferred feature:
- source/reference ID
- source type
- extracted characteristic
- confidence
- VERIFIED / INFERRED / SPECULATIVE
- affected asset(s)
- expert owner

Conflict rule: detect version/configuration differences, prefer matching date/model/location, research further, and escalate to the user only when the ambiguity materially changes user intent.
